name: Path of Uther
summary: The Path of Uther is the somber stone walkway climbing the slopes of Sorrow Hill toward the tomb of Uther the Lightbringer. Cutting through a graveyard overrun by the restless dead, it serves as the final approach to one of Lordaeron's most revered sanctuaries.

sections.title: The Road to the Lightbringer
sections.body: Winding up through the gloom of Sorrow Hill in the southern Western Plaguelands, the Path of Uther guides mourners and pilgrims toward the sepulcher of Lordaeron's first paladin. While the surrounding hillside teems with roaming ghouls and skeletal horrors, the walkway itself remains a steadfast beacon for those traveling to honor the fallen hero. Stepping onto these stones offers a grim transition from the plagued wilds into the lingering sanctity of Uther's final resting place.

aliases: where does path of uther go
what is at the end of the path
faq.answer: The walkway leads directly up the hill to Uther's Tomb, the solemn monument housing the remains of High General Uther the Lightbringer.
The path cuts through Sorrow Hill, a vast cemetery completely overrun by the Scourge. Uncontrolled skeletons, ghouls, and wandering undead prowl within paces of the walkway.
No organized army holds the path in the present day. Only devoted pilgrims of the Alliance and hermits tending the nearby tomb brave the Scourge to keep vigil over the site.

angles.text: Treading the Path of Uther is a solemn rite of passage for knights of the Silver Hand, leading to the resting place of their founder and supreme model of devotion.
For Alliance forces fighting in the Plaguelands, this path stands as a painful reminder of Lordaeron's fall and the heroic figures lost during the Third War.
